top_signals.title: Trump Announces $80 Billion Taiwan LNG Deal
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump has announced a massive new energy agreement with Taiwan, claiming the island will purchase between $70 billion and $80 billion worth of liquefied natural gas from Alaska over the next two decades, as Asian importers scramble to secure supplies beyond the increasingly dangerous Strait of Hormuz. In a Truth Social post on Wednesday, Trump said Taiwan had committed to purchasing 30% of the planned Alaska LNG project's output for 20 years, alongside a $4.4 billion equity investment. The president described the arrangement as…

top_signals.title: Organizations join forces to fight Illinois crypto tax, after 6-month pause
top_signals.summary: Illinois officials already agreed to delay implementation of a 0.2% tax on crypto assets, but industry-aligned organizations are pushing for summary judgment on the merits.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
